This '''power plant''' was located inside the [[Oznek capital city|capital city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oznek]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a [[Banks's squadron|squad]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Banks (clone)|Banks]] went on a [[Mission to Oznek|mission]] to destroy this [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]], after having been led to believe it was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[command center]].<ref name="TEW" />
